QueryFluxRunFacet.description: How QueryFlux routed and ran the query.

clusterGroup.description: The cluster group the query was routed to.

engine.description: The engine type, e.g. trino, snowflake, duckDb.

sourceDialect.description: The SQL dialect the client sent.

targetDialect.description: The SQL dialect the engine received.

translated.description: Whether the SQL was translated between dialects.

rewritten.description: Whether access control rewrote the SQL (row filters, column masks).

cacheHit.description: Whether the result came from the QueryFlux result cache.

ColumnsReadDatasetFacet.description: The columns a query read from an input dataset, when the catalog schema let QueryFlux attribute them.
